title: Multiple Slides per View
description: A carousel that shows one, two, or three slides at a time, from container queries on a parent that give each CarouselSlide a basis class for its share of the row less the gaps. Every slide snaps and has its own dot, the buttons move one slide at a time, and fades keep the slides beside the row visible but faded. Use it for a row of cards, products, or templates, and the root Carousel for one slide at a time.
